gaps.quote: leaves margin $2^{-b}$ against amplification up to $2^{5b+4}$
gaps.note: Not in the paper and not supported by the page's own bound. The amplification is 2^{2b+4}S with errors up to about 28*2^gamma*T^2*L, so 2^{5b+4}*2^{-6b}=2^{-b+4}, not 2^{-b}; the displayed bound actually obtained is 448 b 2^{-b+gamma}, which exceeds 2^{-b}. The correct statement is the displayed bound 448 b 2^{-b+gamma} <= 448 b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2 (paper lines 4722-4727).
